params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $legacyTask=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'HeavenLocalBridge' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($legacyTask){ Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'HeavenLocalBridge' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'HeavenLocalBridge' -Confirm:$false }; $legacy=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*\HeavenBridge\relay\heaven-bridge\worker.ps1*' }); $ids=@($legacy | ForEach-Object {[int]$_.ProcessId}); foreach($pidToStop in $ids){ Stop-Process -Id $pidToStop -Force -ErrorAction Stop }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 750; $remaining=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*\HeavenBridge\relay\heaven-bridge\worker.ps1*' }); if($remaining.Count -ne 0){ throw ('Legacy workers remain: '+(($remaining|ForEach-Object {$_.ProcessId}) -join ',')) }; 'LEGACY_BRIDGE_RETIRED pids='+($ids -join ',')
